en.title: Three questions before the next lot handoff
en.lead: Are the reports describing the same lot, stage and recording time? Which source record supports the handoff? Who confirms missing information before the next step? Use these three questions to review your workflow, then explore linked production records in a named China case using integrated Digiwin ERP + iMES.

en.contextTitle: Records and processes need to work together
en.contextBody: According to the case published by Digiwin Vietnam, 江苏中科智芯集成科技有限公司 in China implemented an integrated ERP + iMES solution. The published problems include disorganized records, nonstandard processes and low outsourcing and production efficiency.
en.mechanismLead: The published mechanisms span shopfloor data, production records, parameter changes and exception handling within the integrated solution.
en.valueTitle: Use three questions to prepare the next handoff
en.valueLead: Bring Operations and Quality into the same discussion about comparison scope, source records and confirmation responsibilities.
en.v1Title: Compare the same lot, stage and recording time
en.v1Body: Do the reports describe the same process stage and recording time? Different status reports may both be correct when their context differs.
en.v1Prepare: Prepare two status reports for one lot, with the stage and recording time of each.
en.v2Title: Identify the record that supports the handoff
en.v2Body: Which source record supports the next step, and what information does the receiving team need?
en.v2Prepare: Prepare the source record for one handoff and the receiving team’s information requirements.
en.v3Title: Make the confirmation owner and next check clear
en.v3Body: Who checks missing information and its source, and who confirms the next step before the receiving team updates lot status?
en.v3Prepare: Prepare the confirmation roles and one example of missing information in a lot handoff.
en.bridge: A shared view of lot context, source records and responsibilities can help teams identify where a handoff needs attention. Start the discussion with one actual handoff at your company.

en.consultBody: Describe how Operations and Quality compare status reports, confirm the source record and assign the next check. We provide digital solutions for manufacturing, from ERP to smart manufacturing.
